verdict.rationale: Extend provides a documented public API with authentication, endpoints (upload, extract, classify, split, parse), sync/async modes, SDKs, CLI, and a dedicated API Quickstart, giving AI-native users a clear path to drive the product programmatically. Community feedback confirms real-world usage of the product's data extraction capabilities. missing for 10: independent third-party validation specifically of API robustness/rate limits beyond docs.
